title: Safety by Design: Realized-Cost Constraints for Contextual Bandits with Continuous Actions
abstract: arXiv:2608.26755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contextual bandits are a standard framework for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, with applications in clinical trials, dosage selection, recommendation systems, and autonomous systems. Safety is central in many of these applications, since a single unsafe decision in settings such as dosage selection or autonomous driving can have catastrophic consequences. A common way to model safety in bandit problems is to associate each action with both a reward signal and a cost signal, and to optimize reward subject to constraints on cost. Most existing safety-constrained bandit models enforce safety by requiring the expected cost of each action to remain below a prescribed threshold. However, this may be insufficient in heteroscedastic settings, where the chosen action affects not only the expected reward and cost, but also the variability of the observed outcomes. translated_title: 安全设计：连续动作上下文赌博机的已实现成本约束
translated_abstract: 上下文赌博机是在不确定性下进行序贯决策的标准框架，应用于临床试验、剂量选择、推荐系统和自主系统。在许多此类应用中，安全性至关重要，因为在剂量选择或自动驾驶等场景中，一次不安全的决策可能带来灾难性后果。在赌博机问题中，建模安全的一种常见方式是将每个动作与奖励信号和成本信号关联，并在成本约束下优化奖励。大多数现有的安全约束赌博机模型通过要求每个动作的期望成本保持在规定阈值以下来确保安全。然而，在异方差环境中，所选动作不仅影响期望奖励和成本，还影响观测结果的变异性，此时这种方法可能不足。我们研究具有一维连续动作的上下文赌博机。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对连续动作上下文赌博机的“已实现成本”约束方法，以应对异方差环境下仅约束期望成本不足的安全问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "realized-cost" constraint approach for contextual bandits with continuous actions, addressing safety issues in heteroscedastic settings where expected-cost constraints are insufficient.
